title: Banks in Rochdale: which branches are open, which have closed, and the Heywood banking hub
seo_title: Banks in Rochdale: branches, closures and hubs
description: Which bank branches are still open in Rochdale town centre, which have closed, what HSBC Rochdale now offers, the Heywood banking hub's days, and banking at the Post Office.
lede: Bank branches across the Rochdale borough have closed one after another since 2023. This is what is still open, what each branch can do, and where to go for face-to-face banking now.

sections.heading: Rochdale town centre
sections.html:
BranchAddressWhat it offers
Nationwide112/114 Yorkshire Street, OL16 1XNFull branch. Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 9am–4.30pm; Wednesday 10am–4.30pm; Saturday 9am–12 noon. Nationwide has promised to keep it open until at least the start of 2030. Phone 0345 266 0724.
HalifaxYorkshire StreetFull branch with a paying-in machine. Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 9.30am–4.30pm; Wednesday 10am–4.30pm; Saturday 9.30am–3pm. Lloyds Bank customers can use it too.
HSBC2 Yorkshire Street, OL16 1EESelf-service only: cash withdrawals and note deposits. No counter or coin service. Appointments can be booked, and there is a quiet hour from 2pm to 3pm, Monday to Friday.
Barclays1 Yorkshire Street, OL16 1BHCheck Barclays' branch finder for current hours before you travel.

sections.heading: Branches that have closed
sections.html:
• NatWest, Town Hall Square, Rochdale closed on 10 June 2025.
  • NatWest, Long Street, Middleton closed on 30 April 2025.
  • Lloyds, 58 Yorkshire Street, Rochdale closed on 1 October 2026. Lloyds customers can use the Halifax branch on Yorkshire Street.
  • Heywood's last bank branch closed before the town's banking hub was set up.

sections.heading: Heywood banking hub
sections.html:
The hub opened in its permanent home on 23 October 2026, in a purpose-built unit in the Morrisons car park at Times Retail Park, Dawson Street, Heywood OL10 4PN. Customers of all the main banks can use its Post Office counter to pay in and withdraw cash, pay in cheques and check balances, any weekday from 9am to 5pm.

Each day a different bank has its own community banker there:

DayCommunity banker
MondaySantander
TuesdayBarclays
WednesdayLloyds, Halifax, Bank of Scotland
ThursdayNatWest
FridayHSBC

The temporary hub at Heywood Post Office on Market Street has closed.

sections.heading: Banking at the Post Office
sections.html: Customers of most UK banks can pay in cash and cheques, take out cash and check their balance over the counter at any Post Office. That includes branches across Rochdale, Middleton, Littleborough and Milnrow.
